about: The operating systems the isle is run on, and what differs between them for packages. Read by isle os (supported_os.py) and by isle apt-repo publish, which files a dependency set only under a release name listed here. A proof says how far a system is proven in a role: live-verified (a real machine of an isle runs it in that role), source-tested (proven in tests only), not proven. Every value below was read on a machine or in the build scripts; the place is named in evidence.

variations: The offline dependency list is written with this release's package names (libgtk-3-0t64, libasound2t64).
The full offline medium (router image, dependency set, container images) is built and installed for this release.
evidence: core: a core runs this release with CLI release 89 (read on the machine 2026-11-21: apt 2.8.4, python 3.12.3, amd64)
member: test-apt-deps-index.py installs as a member in a container of this release; no real member runs it yet
baseImage: build-offline-bundle.sh resolves the dependency set in this image

variations: Two libraries carry their older names here (packageNames): 24.04 renamed them with the t64 suffix.
systemd-resolved is not a package of its own here: it is part of systemd (24.04 split it out).
python3 is 3.10: every isle CLI script has to run on it, so nothing newer than 3.10 is used in them.
A core has never been installed on this release; the offline medium can be built for it (--target ubuntu-22.04) but that build is not proven by an install.
evidence: member: two members run this release with CLI release 89 (read on the machines 2026-11-21: apt 2.4.14 and 2.4.15, python 3.10.12, amd64)

packageNames: build-offline-medium.sh replaces the two library names for --target ubuntu-22.04; systemd-resolved has no candidate in the base image of this release (read 2026-11-21), and the dependency list resolves once it is named systemd
dependency set: built for this release on 2026-11-22 from the offline dependency list (930 packages, 540 MB, every one checked against the signed archive index); not published on a core yet
baseImage: build-offline-bundle.sh resolves the dependency set in this image
